title: One-Layer Transformers Provably Learn In-Context K-Nearest Neighbor Prediction with Chain-of-Thought
abstract: arXiv:2610.16798v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) enables transformers to solve complex reasoning tasks by generating intermediate reasoning steps. Despite strong empirical success, the mechanisms by which such reasoning abilities emerge during training remain poorly understood, particularly from a theoretical perspective. In this work, we study this question in a stylized yet fully analyzable setting: in-context $\mathrm{K}$-nearest-neighbor ($\mathrm{K}$-NN) prediction with a one-layer transformer. Earlier work has demonstrated that one-layer transformers can be trained to perform $1$-NN without CoT (Li et al., 2024a) by having the softmax attention attend to the nearest neighbor in context. However, this result on $1$-NN cannot be extended to $\mathrm{K}$-NN for $K>1$, as softmax attention is much less naturally suited to attending to the 2nd through $K$-th nearest neighbors. We first give a rigorous negative result showing that this limitation already appear

translated_title: 单层Transformer可通过思维链可证明地学习上下文K近邻预测
translated_abstract: 思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）使Transformer能够通过生成中间推理步骤来解决复杂的推理任务。尽管在实证上取得了巨大成功，但这种推理能力在训练过程中如何涌现的机制仍知之甚少，特别是从理论角度来看。在这项工作中，我们在一个风格化但完全可分析的设置中研究这一问题：基于单层Transformer的上下文内K近邻（K-NN）预测。先前的工作（Li et al., 2024a）已经证明，单层Transformer可以在不使用思维链的情况下被训练来执行1近邻预测，其方式是让softmax注意力关注上下文中最近的邻居。然而，这一关于1近邻的结果无法扩展到K>1的K近邻预测，因为softmax注意力天然不适合同时关注第2至第K近的邻居。我们首先给出了一个严格的否定性结果，表明这一局限性已经出现（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文从理论上证明单层Transformer可通过思维链训练可证明地学会上下文中的K近邻预测，突破了softmax注意力难以直接关注多个近邻的固有局限。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that one-layer transformers can provably learn in-context K-nearest-neighbor prediction through chain-of-thought training, overcoming the inherent limitation that softmax attention cannot naturally attend to multiple nearest neighbors.
